items.title: Compliance API coverage extends to Claude Cowork and Claude Code | Claude by Anthropic
items.summary_1line: Claude's Compliance API now covers Cowork across the desktop app, web, and mobile, as well as Claude Code in the CLI and desktop app. Coverage is in beta for Claude Enterprise customers.
items.editor_note: Anthropic extends the Compliance API to Cowork and Claude Code, in beta for Enterprise customers.

items.title: Claude Cowork comes to the Chrome side panel | Claude by Anthropic
items.summary_1line: The Claude in Chrome side panel is now a Claude Cowork session. Your conversations, skills, and connectors carry between the browser and the Claude apps.
items.editor_note: Cowork reaches the Chrome side panel, carrying sessions between the browser and the Claude apps.

items.title: Against Claude Cowork, DeepSeek opens its open-source Harness to developers - TechNode
items.summary_1line: Against Claude Cowork, DeepSeek opens its open-source Harness to developers TechNode
items.editor_note: DeepSeek frames its open-source Harness as the alternative to Cowork while opening it to outside developers.

editorial.tldr: Anthropic expanded Claude Cowork twice in three days — Compliance API coverage for Enterprise customers, then a Chrome side-panel integration that carries sessions between the browser and the Claude apps. Two days later, DeepSeek framed its own open-source Harness tool explicitly as an alternative to Cowork.
editorial.whats_new: DeepSeek positioned its open-source Harness as a direct alternative to Claude Cowork, two days after Cowork's Chrome side-panel launch.
editorial.why_it_matters: Cowork is now explicitly the incumbent a rival is positioning against, not just a Claude Code companion — platform engineers picking a collaborative-agent tool should compare Cowork's compliance and cross-surface session continuity against Harness feature-by-feature, not take either vendor's framing at face value.
editorial.take_for_builders: If evaluating collaborative-agent tools, compare Cowork's Compliance API coverage and cross-surface session continuity against Harness feature-by-feature before treating either vendor's competitive framing as settled.

status.state: Cowork expanding access; DeepSeek positions Harness against it
status.detail: Anthropic shipped compliance coverage and a Chrome integration for Cowork in quick succession; DeepSeek then framed its own Harness tool as the alternative.

beats.headline: Claude's Compliance API extends to Cowork and Claude Code
beats.summary: Compliance API coverage reaches Cowork across desktop, web, and mobile, plus Claude Code in the CLI and desktop app — in beta for Enterprise customers.

beats.headline: Cowork comes to the Chrome side panel
beats.summary: The Claude-in-Chrome side panel becomes a full Cowork session, carrying conversations, skills, and connectors between the browser and the Claude apps.

beats.headline: DeepSeek frames its open-source Harness as the alternative to Cowork
beats.summary: TechNode reports DeepSeek positioning Harness explicitly against Cowork as it opens the tool to outside developers.

open_questions: Does DeepSeek's Harness actually match Cowork's compliance coverage and cross-surface session continuity, or is the 'against' framing marketing rather than a feature-for-feature claim?
Will Cowork's Compliance API and Chrome integration expand to further surfaces or leave beta for Enterprise customers?
